mapper.select: select p.close_begin_time, p.close_end_time, p.id as projectId, p.project_code, p.project_name, p.user_id, su.nick_name, ps.stage_code, ps.stage_name, p.type as projectType, p.status, p.published, p.project_process, p.created_time, p.updated_time, p.description, p.cover, p.auto_update_process, p.open_prefix, p.prefix, p.open_task_private, p.msg_notify, p.notify_day from pmhub_project p left join pmhub_project_stage ps on p.project_stage_id = ps.id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = p.user_id where p.id = #{projectId} and p.deleted = 0
mapper.update: update pmhub_project set deleted = 1, deleted_time = #{deletedTime}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = #{updatedTime} where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
